import paramiko
import time
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')
# Build APK
cmd = """export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64
export ANDROID_HOME=~/android-sdk
export PATH=/opt/gradle-8.5/bin:$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH
cd /opt/areloria/client/android
nohup /opt/gradle-8.5/bin/gradle clean assembleDebug > /tmp/gradle.log 2>&1 &
echo "Build started with PID: $!" """
c.exec_command(cmd)
print("🏗️ Build started...")
# Wait for build
time.sleep(60)
# Check result
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("tail -20 /tmp/gradle.log")
print("Log:", stdout.read().decode())
# Check APK
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("ls -lh /opt/areloria/client/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk 2>/dev/null || echo 'No APK yet'")
print("APK:", stdout.read().decode())
c.close()
